column2: A comet seen in the sky is regarded by some as an omen, others think it is actually a kingdom of spirits floating in the sky, and still others believe the comet is a giant ice ball grazing across the sky with its tail created by the sun's energy. All three views have promoted our nation's quest for knowledge.
